Как считается: порядок движения цены вну: How it is computed: the order of price movement within a candle is unknown, so both paths are computed (high first or low first) and the worse one is taken. A limit order fills exactly at its price, with a fee; market trades (starting buy, stop, take-profit, trailing) — with a fee and slippage. The spot grid fee comes from the general settings at the top, the futures grid fee from the "Futures fee" field; the general "Leverage" field does not apply to the grid. For the futures grid also: liquidation is checked at every point of the candle in the worst order of movement, and after it the stake is considered fully lost; funding follows the payment history of the chosen exchange, the position for the payment is the worse of the candle's start and end.
What part of the account goes into each trade. At 50 % half the money buys the coin and half waits in cash: both the profit and the loss of a trade are half as large on the account, and the fee is paid only on the invested half.

Фьючерсная сетка торгует бессрочным фьюч: A futures grid trades a perpetual future, not the coin. The investment serves as collateral (margin), and the positions of all cells together are investment × leverage. Round-trip profit grows with leverage, but so does the loss when the price leaves the range: a long grid builds a leveraged position in a fall, a short grid in a rise. If the loss eats the collateral down to the maintenance margin, the exchange closes the position (liquidation), and the investment is lost. Plus funding: every few hours the long pays the short (or vice versa).
